🎤✨ Show: The Next Headliner

Five girls with dreams of making it big in music find themselves thrown into a competition where every performance could bring them one step closer to the spotlight. They each have something to prove, but the pressure of auditions, expectations, and constantly being compared to one another makes the journey anything but easy.

Along the way, competition turns into friendship as they begin opening up about their fears and supporting each other through the highs and lows. Instead of letting their differences tear them apart, they discover that their individual personalities and talents can actually work together.

Soon, the girls stop thinking about who will become the next headliner and start thinking about what they can create together. Their journey leads them toward forming a band and pursuing their dream on their own terms.

The cast includes Olivia Taylor Cohen, Kate Mina Lin, Journey Montana, Indi Star, and Giselle Torres.
